prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1350; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with ongoing right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Over the course of 29 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, activity modification, anti-inflammatory medication, and a structured home exercise program. The mechanism of injury, a rear impact with forward and rebound loading of the lower extremity, is consistent with the type of knee trauma described. Early visits were more frequent, and the frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved and strength and mobility returned. Examination findings include localized tenderness and a positive effusion sign along the medial joint line, which support the reported injury. Other ligamentous and neurovascular tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this knee, and no earlier records were identified that would suggest a pre-existing condition. Billing records were reviewed and reflect no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. At discharge, the patient was improving with residual mild stiffness and was released to independent exercise with follow-up as needed.
